response.text:
```python
def exchange(lst1, lst2):
    odd_count = sum(1 for i in lst1 if i % 2 == 1)
    even_count = sum(1 for i in lst2 if i % 2 == 0)
    return "YES" if even_count >= odd_count else "NO"
```
